create.name: Barrie Risman
create.bio:
Barrie Risman is a yoga teacher and writer who lives in Sutton, in Quebec's Eastern Townships, and teaches students and teachers both online and in person. Originally from New York, she has taught yoga full time since 1999. Her background includes several years on the staff of the SYDA Foundation in India and the United States, a long period as a senior Anusara Yoga teacher trainer, and more than twenty-five years of study in the Iyengar tradition. She later co-directed Shri Yoga in Montreal, and she also facilitates Joanna Macy's Work That Reconnects.

Her classes join careful, alignment-based posture work with the philosophy of yoga, treating practice as a path of self-knowledge and inner growth rather than exercise alone. She runs a yearly online subscription of livestreamed classes with a library of recordings, a monthly online satsang of talk, meditation, breathwork and discussion, and teacher trainings and mentoring. Her book Evolving Your Yoga, which has a foreword by Sophie Grégoire Trudeau, sets out the principles behind her teaching, and she writes a weekly blog called Beyond Asana. She has led programmes at Kripalu.

courses.title: Yoga for Turbulent Times: Online Class Subscription
courses.description: A year-round online subscription of livestreamed yoga classes with Barrie, each recorded for later viewing, plus access to a library of earlier series. The monthly satsangs are included, and a free trial is offered.
courses.price: $250 USD per year ($320 CAD) or $49 USD per month ($57 CAD)

courses.title: Yoga for Turbulent Times Monthly Satsang
courses.description: A monthly online gathering on Zoom that opens with a talk drawn from yoga philosophy and moves into guided meditation, breathwork, quiet reflection and group conversation. Anyone who signs up receives the recording.

free_resources.title: The Yoga We Need Now: Free Video Series
free_resources.description: Six short talks sent over two weeks, taken from Barrie's online workshops, on themes such as staying steady through change, the breath as a companion, and gratitude. Sign-up by email.
